residuals.description: The B1 Source Hub and Evidence Workspace are implemented and CI-validated, but the current Vercel connector exposes no visible CEW project and its deploy action has an inconsistent schema: the published tool accepts no arguments while the backend requires target, name and files. A real B1 production deploy and smoke therefore cannot be certified from the available integration.
residuals.required_resolution: Establish a functioning CEW Vercel project/deploy channel, deploy the current branch, then verify authenticated Project Home -> Source Hub -> verified primary-source PDF/render -> Evidence Workspace MICRO/MESO/MACRO without submitting a fabricated production human receipt.

authority_boundary: B1 adds source/evidence user workflow, verified immutable-source retrieval, derived reading views and natural-language review compatibility only. It does not modify F2 geometry, N12 engineering facts, structural bindings, calculation readiness or canonical write authority.
